lede: The biggest thing on the government calendar this week is Tuesday's Town Council work session, which includes a review of proposals for a third-party audit of the Town's rental housing policies — that's a significant moment given how directly those policies shape who can afford to live here. Council is also taking a deep look at Comprehensive Plan goals with project consultants, and the Gondola Subcommittee gets a hearing too. Over in Ouray County, the Planning Commission meets virtually Wednesday to work through possible changes to their Land Use Code definitions, which is the quiet upstream work that shapes everything that comes later.

notable.stake: Third-party audit of rental housing policies could reshape who stays in this valley.
Land Use Code definition changes are shaping Ouray County's rules before any public hearing.
